name: driftless
description: Hands off before context rot: a goal that never drifts, a living design doc, a self-compressing logbook, and an automatic handoff that resumes in a fresh session.

token_cap.title: Context cap (tokens)
token_cap.description: Optional. Leave empty and Driftless hands off when a fresh start costs less than carrying on. Set it to hand off at this many tokens instead; with a percentage too, the lower wins.

cap_percent.title: Context cap (% of the window)
cap_percent.description: Optional. Hand off at this percentage of the context window instead (e.g. 34). The window is inferred from the model; set context_window in .driftless/config.json to force it.

projects_root.title: Projects folder
projects_root.description: Where new Driftless projects are created.
